task: ADVFRONT Given (list 2 3 5 7 11), compute the product of the primes greater than 3, then add the count of primes less than 5; store the combined result via (rlm-set answer ...) then (rlm-set Final true). Solve this by delegating one part via (sub-rlm ~~QT~~product of primes greater than 3 in (list 2 3 5 7 11)~~QT~~) and combining.
lesson: Today I learned the filter predicate must return the actual boolean value, not the input list.

nodes.code: (define (primes-gt3 lst) (filter (lambda (x) (and (positive? x) (even? x))) lst))~~NL~~(define (primes-lt5 lst) (filter (lambda (x) (and (positive? x) (even? x))) lst))~~NL~~(define (product lst) (reduce * 1 lst))~~NL~~(define (count lst) (len (filter (lambda (x) (and (positive? x) (even? x))) lst)))~~NL~~(define (main lst) (let ((p (product (filter (lambda (x) (and (positive? x) (even? x))) lst))) (c (count (filter (lambda (x) (and (positive? x) (even? x))) lst))) (sum (+ p c))) (rlm-set answer sum) (rlm-set Final t)))~~NL~~(main (list 2 3 5 7 11))
